notes.title: Update 1.0
notes.notes:
First of all, thanks to everyone who has played my first horror game so far. I've loved reading all your comments and reviews and watching your playthroughs. So again, thanks. Now, on to the news. Almost a week after the release of Honey Are You There here is the first update of the game containing some requested features. 

Whats new:

-Fixed bugs
-Added hints in the game.
-Added objectives
-Enable numpad interaction
-Slower walk


P.S. I am in the making of a new horror game so get ready!!!
More infortmation about my new future project soon :)
